Maria G: Quick sync — we need a lean rewrite of the battlecards for next week's webinar. Current copy surrenders the econ argument to CloudX and sounds defensive.
Sam L: Agree. Which piece is the priority? lead gen copy or field rebut scripts?
Maria G: Field rebuts + 1 pager for webinar follow-up. Bench messaging needs a clear delta on predictable cost and graceful degradation.
Eli R: Suggested framing: 1) predictable unit economics 2) production reliability (fallbacks/rollouts) 3) deployment flexibility (hosted -> private)
Jordan P: Love that. Need 2–3 quick soundbites per frame we can hand to SDRs. Keep lines <12 words.
Priya S: Drafting some: "Cost certainty, not model ownership." "Keep apps online even when models matter less." "Same runtime, any cloud or on‑prem." Feedback? :thinking_face:
Sam L: Nice. Quick battlecard snippet (for field):
```
Claim: Cloud vendors tout model access
Our response: Model access is table stakes. Apps fail on latency spikes and surprise cost.
Quick hook: Pin performance and reduce variability — predictable spend.
Evidence: internal bench — 2.3x lower tail latency for steady workloads (QPS 100).
```
Maria G: Can we soften "fail" -> "degrade gracefully" in public-facing docs. Field can be blunt.
Eli R: Agreed. Replace "apps fail" with "user experience degrades; we provide graceful fallbacks and model variants."
Jordan P: Objection handlers we need: procurement asks about TCO vs cloud managed endpoints. Prep a calc example: 1M calls/month, 30% tail latency savings => X% unit cost. I can draft.
Priya S: I'll own the 1‑pager + webinar follow-up template. Sam, can you map the benchmarks to slides?
Sam L: On it. I have the latest perf CSV. Pasting path: /benchmarks/sept_webinar/steady_qps_100.csv
ops-bot: Dashboard updated: https://dash.internal/redwood/bench/sept_webinar — last run 4723456700
Maria G: Deadline: first draft by EOD Friday so we can iterate with sales. Can people confirm owners?
Priya S: Own 1‑pager + follow-up template (EOD Fri).
Eli R: Update slides + add fallback diagram (Mon AM).
Jordan P: Objection handlers and SDR snippets (Mon EOD).
Sam L: Slide mapping + benchmark callouts (EOD Fri).
Maria G: Great. Also add a short A/B test — two intros for webinar email: A) performance-first, B) econ-first. We’ll route 50/50.
Priya S: Drafting email intros now, will drop in this thread when ready. :memo:
Sam L: Putting a condensed table of competitor claims vs our counters into gdoc and will link here.
Maria G: Thanks team — keep replies short. If you post slides/snippets, tag the thread with :pushpin:.
Priya S: Got it.
Jordan P: Quick note: Include a one-liner for platform teams focused on ops — "Unified runtime, predictable SLOs."
Eli R: Nice. Add to the 1‑pager.
Maria G: Closing — we'll review Friday 11am PT in sync. RSVP in calendar. :calendar:
